system.description:
• A ranger who specialises in tracking and killing dangerous creatures rather than humanoid enemies — beasts, magical creatures, undead, anything that preys on settlements or travellers. Contract work, bounties, or pure calling.
  • Beast-Marked: Combat Marauder's damage bonus applies to beasts, magical beasts, and undead in addition to humanoids and giants.
  • Hunter's Eye: Advantage on Track checks when following a non-humanoid creature. Advantage on checks to identify a creature's type, weaknesses, or habitat from tracks, kills, or signs of its passage.
